record.label: Coefficient lookup by interference and phase correction
record.statement: The lookup uses Hadamards and $T$ and $T^\dagger$ gates to compute the coefficient bits by interference. The $Z$ and $CZ$ corrections cancel the input-dependent signs within each lookup pass.
record.boundary: The first Hadamard creates two branches on the coefficient qubit. The $T$ and $T^\dagger$ gates record bit products in their relative phase, and the second Hadamard and final Clifford gates give the coefficient bit and a residual sign. An input-dependent sign can change a superposition even when all basis-state labels are correct. The two lookup passes each cancel their accumulated sign.
